body.p: A blood pressure measurement module, a strap assembly, and a wearable device are provided. The blood pressure measurement module can be mounted on a strap of the wearable device. The blood pressure measurement module includes a housing, a measurement assembly and a wireless communication module. The housing is provided with an accommodation cavity, and the housing is connected to the strap. The measurement assembly is used for measuring the blood pressure, and the measurement assembly includes a light emitter and a light receiver. The light emitter and the light receiver are both arranged in the accommodation cavity. The light receiver is used for receiving the light that is emitted by the light emitter and reflected to the light receiver by a human body.
